en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square dominated by a tall church tower with a clock and a steep, multi‑tiered spire topped by a weather vane. Around the base of the tower stand 2–3 story houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. Shop signs in German are visible at street level, and a few people in early 20th‑century dress stand or walk in the open square. The upper sky area appears overexposed or masked, emphasizing the tower silhouette.
